Psycho Chaser.name: Psycho Chaser
Psycho Chaser.summary: Psycho Chaser is a vertically-scrolling sci-fi shooter. The player takes control of the titular battle android. There are multiple weapons which can be picked up and freely switched between, and also power-ups which allow for weapon and energy upgrades between stages.

Takeda Shingen.name: Takeda Shingen
Takeda Shingen.summary: A side-scrolling brawler for the Arcade and PC Engine featuring the titular Japanese Sengoku warlord. Not to be confused with the NES strategy game of the same name.

Tricky.name: Tricky
Tricky.summary: Kicking-things puzzle game that is guaranteed to twist your brain up until it escapes out of your nostrils.
